commands.description: Discover types in a package or library (compact table output)

options.name: --package
options.description: Source: package (file, name, name@version, or name@A..B)

options.name: --at
options.description: Address in a package range: exact version, #N, first, or last

options.name: --library
options.description: Source: library path (local file, or relative within package)

options.name: --platform
options.description: Source: platform library (e.g., System.Text.Json)

options.name: --project
options.description: Source: restored project.assets.json context

options.name: --framework
options.description: Source: platform framework (runtime, aspnetcore, netstandard). @version for specific

options.name: --tfm
options.description: Source: select by TFM (e.g., net8.0)

options.name: --all
options.description: Include non-public, hidden, and obsolete members

options.name: --type
options.description: Filter types by glob pattern (e.g., *Json*, Progress*)

options.name: --json
options.description: Output as JSON

options.name: --compact
options.description: Output as minified JSON (use with --json)

options.name: --raw

options.description: Emit GitHub URLs as browser-friendly /blob/ URLs (URL-shape modifier, not an output-shape modifier)

options.name: --table
options.description: Output as a pretty table (space-padded columns)

options.name: --tsv
options.description: Output as normalized tab-separated values

options.name: --jsonl
options.description: Output as JSON Lines (one object per row)

options.name: --no-headers
options.description: Suppress table/TSV column headers

options.name: --shape
options.description: Output type shape (inheritance, interfaces, members)

options.name: --unsafe
options.description: Filter types with unsafe signatures (pointers)

options.name: --repo
options.description: Read PDB-mapped type source from local git clone(s) by SourceLink commit + PDB checksum, before the network. Can repeat.

options.name: --member
options.description: Filter members by name or limit count (-m 5)

options.name: --kind
options.description: Filter by kind (class, struct, interface, enum, delegate, method, property, field, event, constructor)

options.name: --discover
options.description: Discover schema: sections, or items within a section

options.name: --section
options.description: Select sections/categories by name or wildcard (comma/semicolon-separated)

options.name: --columns
options.description: Filter columns by name (comma/semicolon-separated)

options.name: --fields
options.description: Filter fields by name (comma/semicolon-separated)

options.name: --schema
options.description: With -D: show the full static schema without resolving/loading source (offline)

options.name: --tree
options.description: Show hierarchical output when supported

options.name: --count
options.description: Reduce a selected table/vector to a single row count

options.name: --print
options.description: Print one document behind a selected section row; use --row N|first|last to choose a row when multiple rows are printable

options.name: --row
options.description: With --print or a shape projection, select a printable row: a 1-based index, first, or last

options.name: --value
options.description: Print one scalar value from a selected section; use --row N|first|last when multiple rows exist

options.name: --urls
options.description: Project URL-bearing selected section rows to a URL list or JSONL rows

options.name: --paths
options.description: Project path-bearing selected section rows to a path list or JSONL rows

options.name: --json-array
options.description: With a shape projection, emit projected rows as one JSON array

options.name: --loop
options.description: Performance Triage: show only opportunities inside loops

options.name: --min-confidence
options.description: Performance Triage: minimum confidence (low, medium, high)

options.name: --triage-shape
options.description: Performance Triage: include only shape(s), comma-separated or repeated; run -S "Performance Triage" to see shapes

options.name: --top
options.description: Performance Triage: show the top N ranked rows

options.name: --where
options.description: Filter selected section rows with a field predicate, e.g. --where "Allocation=boxed *" or --where "RootReach>=10"

options.name: --order-by
options.description: Order selected section rows by field(s), e.g. --order-by "RootReach desc,Confidence desc"

options.name: --markdown
options.description: Output as markdown

options.name: --plaintext
options.description: Output as plain text

options.name: --bare
options.description: Render the selected payload without document decoration; does not change the selected shape

options.name: --taste
options.description: Render source with the full oracle-endorsed style set (includes byte-divergent lenses); Annotated Source names the applied knobs on the signature

options.name: --readable-names
options.description: Use the default readable local-name synthesis even when configuration disables it; byte-preserving (names do not affect IL)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show progress messages on stderr

options.name: -v
options.description: Verbosity: q(uiet), m(inimal), n(ormal), d(etailed)

options.name: --tips
options.description: Tip verbosity: q(uiet), m(inimal), d(etailed)

options.name: --info
options.description: Show operational metrics (output, time, HTTP, cache) on stderr

options.name: -n
options.description: Count of output lines to keep (like head -n); pair with --tail to take them from the end

options.name: --rows
options.description: Select data rows per rendered table: a count (6), an inclusive range (2..10), a start plus count (2+10), or an open range (10..)

options.name: --head
options.description: Take the count from the start (the default direction)

options.name: --tail
options.description: Take the count from the end instead of the start

options.name: --source
options.description: NuGet source URL (replaces defaults, can repeat)

options.description: NuGet source URL to add (can repeat)
